resources.name: shadcn/ui
resources.license: MIT; verify the selected item and dependencies
resources.adapt: Use as the primary interaction system; customize semantic tokens, typography, density, and real task flows.
resources.inspect: Check current framework setup, components.json aliases, primitive base, forms, focus behavior, and existing source components.

resources.name: Tailark open-source marketing blocks
resources.license: MIT for the open-source repository; paid site offerings are separate
resources.adapt: Select coherent marketing sections around the actual buyer questions; replace demo content and imagery instead of assembling unrelated hero styles.
resources.inspect: Use the open-source registry and its current documented item names. Confirm Base UI versus Radix compatibility; do not assume the full site is free.

resources.name: PrebuiltUI clean UI discovery
resources.license: Custom free/premium terms; standalone kit redistribution is restricted
resources.adapt: Use relevant clean component or layout references for an end product; integrate its own content and behavior.
resources.inspect: The exact search URL could not be retrieved during review; inspect it live or use the components page. Verify item price, implementation, and current license. Do not bundle its source into this toolkit or a competing kit.

resources.name: daisyUI
resources.license: MIT core; inspect any separately sold templates
resources.adapt: Useful for semantic component classes and theme roles across frameworks; tune tokens as a coherent product system.
resources.inspect: Match Tailwind/plugin versions and existing project CSS. Test actual interaction semantics; classes alone do not implement accessible behavior.

resources.name: shadcn-vue
resources.license: Verify the source license at the chosen revision
resources.adapt: Consider Vue-native component source instead of porting React code into a Vue project.
resources.inspect: Check current Vue/Nuxt setup, primitive dependencies, aliases, license, and applicable free components.

resources.name: shadcn-svelte
resources.license: Verify the source license at the chosen revision
resources.adapt: Use Svelte-native source and primitives rather than importing React-only marketing code.
resources.inspect: Confirm Svelte version, Tailwind version, setup, source license, and interaction semantics.

resources.name: TailAdmin React free dashboard
resources.license: MIT free repository; inspect bundled asset rights
resources.adapt: Useful when its navigation and dashboard structure match the real operations task; remove irrelevant cards and metrics.
resources.inspect: Compare the free repository to the paid preview. Review dependencies and data model before adopting a whole template.

resources.name: Landwind
resources.adapt: HTML/Tailwind marketing foundation for straightforward product pages; adapt section order to buyer questions.
resources.inspect: Check build chain and Flowbite versions; replace all unsubstantiated social proof and demo assets.

resources.name: Tabler
resources.license: MIT core; inspect plugins and assets
resources.adapt: Consider for Bootstrap-based operational tools with dense tables, forms, and established administrative patterns.
resources.inspect: Avoid adding Bootstrap beside an established incompatible design system; choose a pinned release and inspect plugins.

resources.name: Flowbite Admin Dashboard
resources.adapt: Use when its HTML/Tailwind administrative structure fits the workflow and reduces implementation cost.
resources.inspect: Review current dependencies, actual free pages, accessibility, and data behavior.

resources.name: Magic UI
resources.license: Inspect selected component license; premium offerings are separate
resources.adapt: One purposeful animated detail may support the visual direction; do not make a whole app depend on decorative effects.
resources.inspect: Verify actual free item, source rights, motion dependencies, reduced-motion behavior, and client performance.

resources.name: React Bits
resources.license: Inspect the selected source's current license and restrictions
resources.adapt: Consider for a clearly justified expressive interaction or visual motif, with a quiet usable surrounding layout.
resources.inspect: Check source license, variant dependencies, motion cost, mobile GPU behavior, and a reduced-motion fallback.

resources.name: Semantic HTML and project CSS
resources.license: Use platform elements and original project code; documentation has separate terms
resources.adapt: Choose custom semantic structure when a library adds more complexity than value. Keep existing design tokens.
resources.inspect: Use mature primitives for complex custom dialogs/menus when needed; test native and composed behavior.

resources.name: Chosen mobile toolkit's native controls
resources.license: Follow the chosen toolkit's terms; platform guidance is not a bundled asset license
resources.adapt: Use the actual platform's navigation, text scaling, touch, safe areas, keyboard and permission patterns.
resources.inspect: Identify target OS and toolkit. For native tasks, web block libraries are references, not drop-in source.

resources.name: Chosen desktop toolkit's native controls
resources.license: Check the chosen toolkit and implementation licenses
resources.adapt: Design for keyboard, resizing, density, selection, menus, file operations, and the actual OS.
resources.inspect: Confirm native toolkit and OS; do not import web blocks into WPF/SwiftUI as if source were compatible.
